pages.text: A $(l)Resin$() is a one-shot additive that makes a print come out $(l)finer$(). Drop one into the $(l)Resin slot$() before you print.$(br2)Resins only work on $(l)official$() blueprints, never your own scans, and are $(l)consumed$() only when they have something to do.

pages.title: Rarity
pages.text: Resins come in three rarities. $(l)Common$() and $(l)Uncommon$() are craftable; $(l)Rare$() is found only, in end-game loot. Rarer resins are stronger, and a few effects exist only at the top.
Everything starts with $(item)Resin Base$(): $(item)Extrudium Crystal$() plus any slimeball. Add a rarity ingredient (a gem makes it $(l)Uncommon$()) and an effect ingredient to finish a resin.
